description: Colombo Municipal Council - Naming the road belonging to Pamankada East Municipal ward as "Edmond Samarawickrema Mawatha"
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively concerns the naming of a public road ("Edmond Samarawickrema Mawatha") by the Colombo Municipal Council. This is a matter of local government administration related to property (public roads) and land identification, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters, including the naming and description of public thoroughfares.
